variables.variableName: Calculate Displayed Weather Type from State Values
variables.toolTip:
If this is true, the widget will use the function "Get Display Name for Current Weather" to get a display name/icon for the weather from the weather state, without it necessarily matching any of the settings assets contributing to state. This is typically best because it handles transitions between states better..
If this is disabled, the widget will get the weather settings asset which is currently most contributing to the local weather state.
